steps.text: Start a new browser session with no saved cookies or cache. Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Home page loaded at https://site.ludus-game.com/, title "LUDUS - Merge Battle Arena PvP Web Shop", cookie banner shown

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: "How we use cookies" banner shown; clicked Dismiss, banner closed

steps.text: Read the Strict-Transport-Security response header (read with execute_script: const r = await fetch(location.href, {cache: 'no-store'}); r.headers.get('<name>')).
Is a Strict-Transport-Security header present with a max-age of at least 31536000?
steps.saw: Present; max-age=63072000 (2 years) >= 31536000, with includeSubDomains and preload
